description: This file is a utility class named ParamChecker that provides static methods to validate method parameters, such as null checks, emptiness checks, and value constraints.

classes.name: ParamChecker
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods for parameter validation, including checks for null, empty collections/arrays/strings, and value ranges.

methods.name: checkNotNull
methods.description: Checks if the provided object is not null; throws IllegalArgumentException if null.

methods.name: checkNotNull(Object...)
methods.description: Checks multiple objects for null, with parameter names 'arg0', 'arg1', etc.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty(String, String)
methods.description: Checks if a string parameter is not null or empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty(Object[], String)
methods.description: Checks if an array is not null or empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty(Collection<?>, String)
methods.description: Checks if a collection is not null or empty.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty(Map<?, ?>, String)
methods.description: Checks if a map is not null or empty.

methods.name: checkGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Checks if an integer parameter is greater than zero.

methods.name: checkNotNullOrEmpty(byte[], String)
methods.description: Checks if a byte array is not null or empty.

methods.name: checkBit
methods.description: Checks if a bit value is between 0 and 7 inclusive.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (String)
methods.description: Returns true if the string is null or has zero length.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (Collection<?>)
methods.description: Returns true if the collection is null or empty.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty (Map<?, ?>)
methods.description: Returns true if the map is null or empty.

methods.name: isValidBit
methods.description: Checks if an integer is a valid bit position between 0 and 7.
